**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no employee non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement covenant. I searched for the full set of detection triggers ("solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ or engage") and read the GENERAL PROVISIONS article in full, plus checked the representations/warranties/covenants articles where such covenants sometimes sit. The only near-hits are unrelated (committee "solicited input", the FTE definition, confidentiality recipient lists, debarment covenants, and indemnitee definitions).

The integration clause (§ 15.9) confirms this Agreement is the entire understanding and expressly supersedes the 2017 Confidentiality Agreement, so no residual non-solicit carries over to bind Sanofi.

This sits at our **preferred** position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), not merely the fallback, so nothing to negotiate here. Worth noting for the deal team: if RevMed later proposes adding a mutual non-solicit, our fallback would accept one limited to personnel directly involved in the collaboration, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
